examples.text: No estoy obligado a hacer eso.
examples.en: I'm not obligated to do that.

examples.text: Me vi obligado a salir ayer.
examples.en: I was obliged to go out yesterday.

examples.text: Fuimos obligados a abandonar nuestro plan.
examples.en: We were obliged to give up our plan.

examples.text: Solo lo hago porque estoy obligado.
examples.en: I'm only doing it because I'm forced to.

examples.text: Si no quieres ir, no estás obligado.
examples.en: If you don't want to go, you don't have to.
